reason: We have decided on the new market and my trade fair contacts will not fill that pipeline, so I need this. The free 15-company list costs me only a call. If the list is good, I would start the pilot in relationship mode, where I approve every message and nothing goes out as mass email under our name.
objection: Our name in a market where nobody knows us yet. One bad message, or one GDPR complaint, and the distributors there will remember us for the wrong reason. Also, a single logistics case is thin proof for wholesale, and I get these agency pitches every week.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies are generic or wrong for our niche, or if the first message reads like a template, I walk away and do not start the pilot.
